scenario: 出题团队要在 45 分钟的面试时长内，用一道题看出候选人的技术判断力，而不能被 AI 一步秒杀。
scenario_en: The interview team has 45 minutes to reveal technical judgment with one problem that AI cannot one-shot.
q: 题库设计时，题目难度该定在什么水平？
q_en: What difficulty level should an interview problem target?
options: 题目只需要考察语法和基础 API 调用，写完能跑就算通过
题目要留出多条路径和非显然方案，但仍能装进 45 分钟
题目越偏门越好，越少候选人接触过就越难被 AI 训练覆盖
题目要能被 AI 一次性直接秒杀，方便统一打分和对比
options_en: The problem only needs to test syntax and basic API calls — if it runs, it passes.
The problem should allow multiple paths and non-obvious solutions while still fitting in 45 minutes.
The more obscure the problem, the better — something few candidates have seen is harder for AI's training data to cover.
The problem should be something AI can one-shot immediately, for uniform, easy-to-compare grading.
why: 题目要能考出判断力：太简单会被 AI 直接解决，太复杂又装不进 45 分钟的面试时长。
why_en: Interview problems must be hard enough to require judgment yet still fit a 45-minute session.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Random[Random easy task] --> AI[AI solves too easily]
  AI --> WeakSignal[Weak signal]
  PatternTask[Pattern rich task] --> StrongSignal[Judgment signal]
optionExplanations: 语法和 API 调用AI几秒就能写完，能跑起来不代表考出了判断力。
对，多路径加非显然方案才能逼出候选人的判断，同时还压得进45分钟。
训练数据覆盖度和判断力是两回事，偏门题只是让评分标准更难说清楚。
AI能秒杀的题目候选人根本没机会展示判断，打分好统一也弥补不了这个缺陷。
optionExplanations_en: AI writes syntax and API calls in seconds; running successfully doesn't mean it tested any judgment.
Right — multiple paths and non-obvious solutions are what force judgment to show, while still fitting 45 minutes.
Training-data coverage has nothing to do with judgment; obscurity just makes scoring criteria harder to pin down.
If AI can one-shot it, the candidate gets no chance to show judgment — uniform grading doesn't make up for that.

scenario: 一道 LeetCode easy 题目，AI 能在几秒内直接给出完整正确解法。
scenario_en: AI can produce a complete correct solution to a LeetCode Easy problem in seconds.
q: 这类题为什么在 AI 编码面试中越来越少见？
q_en: Why are these problems becoming less common in AI coding interviews?
options: 因为候选人考前很容易搜到这类题的标准答案，跟 AI 无关
因为这类题从设计上就不包含真正的算法逻辑，只是语法练习
因为 AI 能一键写出完整答案，留给候选人展示判断的空间太少
因为面试官普遍看不懂这类题目的标准参考解法，没法追问
options_en: Because candidates can easily search up the standard answer beforehand, unrelated to AI.
Because these problems are designed without any real algorithmic logic at all — just syntax drills.
Because AI can one-shot a complete answer, leaving little room for the candidate to show judgment.
Because interviewers generally can't understand the standard reference solutions to these problems, so they can't follow up.
why: 如果 AI 能一键给出完整答案，面试就很难评估候选人的问题映射、取舍和验证能力。
why_en: Simple problems fade out because AI can one-shot them, leaving no room to assess judgment.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个在线算法刷题平台，题目按 Easy/Medium/Hard 分级。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LeetCode is an online platform of algorithm practice problems, rated Easy, Medium, or Hard.

optionExplanations: 搜到答案属于作弊风险，跟 AI 能否直接秒杀是两个不同问题。
easy/medium 题依然有结构化算法逻辑，只是复杂度低，这个说法不成立。
对，AI 一键秒杀之后，候选人几乎没机会展示判断和取舍。
面试官显然看得懂easy/medium级别的标准解法，理解力从不是筛题顾虑。
optionExplanations_en: Searchable answers are a cheating risk, a different problem from whether AI can one-shot it.
Easy/medium problems are still algorithmic and structured, just lower in complexity — this claim doesn't hold.
Right — once AI can one-shot it, the candidate barely gets a chance to show any judgment.
Interviewers clearly understand standard easy/medium solutions; comprehension was never the concern.

scenario: 某公司半年前用来筛选候选人的一道题，最新一代模型现在几分钟就能直接解出正确答案。
scenario_en: A problem that screened candidates six months ago can now be solved correctly by the latest model in minutes.
q: 为什么说 AI 编码题型的平衡会持续被打破？
q_en: Why does the balance of AI coding interview problems keep breaking?
options: 因为候选人能把整套题库和参考答案都提前背下来
因为候选人会把面试题目发到社区论坛上互相公开分享
因为公司内部规定题库五年才轮换更新一次，不管模型进展
模型变强后，公司要重新评估题目是否还有判断力
options_en: Because candidates can memorize the whole question bank and its reference answers in advance.
Because candidates post interview problems to community forums and share them openly.
Because companies have a fixed internal policy to rotate the question bank only once every five years, regardless of model progress.
As models get stronger, companies must reassess whether a problem still tests judgment.
why: 模型变强后，原本能区分候选人的题可能被 AI 直接解决，公司需要持续调整题库。
why_en: The balance keeps breaking because companies must reassess problems as models get better at solving them.
optionExplanations: 背题库能解释题目泄露，但解释不了为什么模型变强会打破平衡。
题目被公开分享是真实风险，但和模型能力变强是两个不同的成因。
题库固定周期更新忽略了模型能力是持续变化的，不是按周期跳变。
对，模型越强，原来能区分人的题就越快失效，逼公司持续调整。
optionExplanations_en: Memorized answer banks explain leaked questions, not why stronger models break the balance.
Public sharing is a real leakage risk, but it's a different cause from rising model capability.
A fixed-cycle update policy ignores that model capability shifts continuously, not on a schedule.
Right — the stronger models get, the faster old discriminating problems stop working, forcing constant updates.

q: 补全 AI 过滤后常留下的题型：
q_en: Complete the problem types that often survive AI filtering:
text: 能留下来的题常聚集在{{依赖解析}}、{{约束满足}}、{{图遍历}}等需要先判断方法的模式上。
why: AI 能实现算法，但从模糊需求识别该用哪种模式仍是候选人的工作。
why_en: Surviving problems cluster around dependency resolution, constraint satisfaction, and graph traversal because the candidate must still choose the approach.

scenario: 同一位候选人分别参加一场传统白板算法面试和一场 AI 编码面试，两场都遇到同一个图遍历问题。
scenario_en: The same candidate sees the same graph traversal problem in a traditional whiteboard interview and an AI coding interview.
q: 掌握算法模式在这两种面试里的作用有什么不同？
q_en: How does algorithm pattern knowledge help differently in these two interview types?
options: 传统面试里模式帮你省时间；AI 面试里模式帮你引导并验证 AI 的深层实现
传统面试里模式帮你选对算法；AI 面试里模式变成了纯粹死记硬背的摆设
无论传统面试还是 AI 面试，模式知识都只是照抄现成模板去套用而已
AI 面试里从头到尾都不需要任何算法模式知识，交给 AI 自己判断就够了
options_en: In a traditional interview, patterns save you time; in an AI interview, they help you steer and verify the AI's deep implementation.
In a traditional interview, patterns help you pick the right algorithm; in an AI interview they're reduced to pure rote memorization.
In both settings, pattern knowledge is only ever used to copy from a ready-made template.
AI interviews never require any algorithmic pattern knowledge at all — just let the AI judge for itself.
why: 传统面试里，模式知识省下写代码的时间；AI 面试里，AI 写实现，模式知识变成引导和验证它的判断力。
why_en: Pattern knowledge saves coding time in traditional interviews, but in AI interviews it becomes the judgment you use to steer and verify the AI.
tradeoff: 省时间直接写代码 vs 引导并验证 AI 的深层实现

rows: 引导 AI 选对方法

optionExplanations: 对，模式知识在两种面试里作用不同：一边省时间，一边负责引导和验证。
传统面试里模式确实帮你选对算法，但AI面试里模式不是摆设，而是用来引导和验证。
套模板忽略了两种面试里模式的作用其实不同，各自服务不同目的。
把判断全交给AI，候选人就没法验证方案对不对，这个说法太绝对。
optionExplanations_en: Right — pattern knowledge plays a different role in each setting: saving time on one side, steering and verifying on the other.
Patterns do help pick the right algorithm in traditional interviews, but in AI interviews they're not decorative — they steer and verify.
Template-copying ignores that pattern knowledge actually plays a different role in each setting.
Handing all judgment to the AI leaves the candidate unable to verify whether the plan is even correct — too absolute.

scenario: 题目其实是一个图连通性问题，但你却告诉 AI 要用 sliding window 来解决。
scenario_en: The problem is really graph connectivity, but you tell the AI to solve it with a sliding window.
q: 常见的结果是什么？
q_en: What is the common result?
options: AI 会自动识别出你说错了，直接换成正确的图算法，不理会提示词
AI 可能硬凑出一个迎合你要求、但本质不合适的扭曲方案
生成的代码一定运行得更快，因为滑动窗口比图遍历更省内存
生成的测试覆盖一定更完整，因为滑动窗口天生自带边界检查
options_en: The AI automatically detects your mistake and switches to the correct graph algorithm, ignoring your wording.
The AI may contort a solution to satisfy your request even though the underlying approach is wrong.
The generated code is guaranteed to run faster, since a sliding window uses less memory than graph traversal.
The generated tests are guaranteed to be more complete, since a sliding window naturally includes boundary checks.
why: 带着错误模式做具体提示，会把 AI 的生成能力引向错误方向，输出看似努力但策略错了。
why_en: A wrong but specific prompt can push the AI into contorting a solution around the wrong pattern.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种维护一个连续区间随窗口移动增删元素的技巧，常用于数组/字符串上的区间统计问题。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A sliding window is a technique that maintains a moving contiguous range over an array or string, adding and removing elements as it slides.

optionExplanations: AI 默认信任你的措辞，不会主动识别错误并换算法，这个说法反了。
对，AI 通常顺着你的措辞硬凑，而不会反过来质疑你的判断。
滑动窗口套在图问题上是绕远路，不会因为形式简单就更省内存或更快。
滑动窗口的边界检查跟测试覆盖率无关，方向错了不会测试反而更全。
optionExplanations_en: AI trusts the wording you give by default and won't proactively detect the mistake and switch algorithms — this claim is backwards.
Right — AI tends to follow your wording and contort a fit rather than question your judgment.
Forcing a sliding window onto a graph problem is a detour — it doesn't save memory or run faster just because it looks simpler.
A sliding window's boundary checks have nothing to do with test coverage; picking the wrong pattern doesn't make tests more complete.

q: 把模式驱动 AI 的健康流程排好：
q_en: Put the healthy workflow for pattern-driven AI in order:
steps: 用足够具体的方式让 AI 实现该模式
把模糊需求映射到合适模式
验证输出是否真的符合模式和约束
向面试官说明为什么这个模式适合
why: 你先识别模式并解释理由，再让 AI 实现，最后审查它有没有按约束正确落地。
why_en: The healthy workflow is map the problem to a pattern, explain it, prompt the AI, then verify the result.
tradeoff: 先判断模式再让 AI 实现 vs 直接把题目丢给 AI 自由发挥
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Read[Read problem] --> Match[Match pattern]
  Match --> Prompt[Prompt with pattern]
  Prompt --> Review[Review invariants]
  Review --> Test[Test edge cases]

scenario: 题目要求在地图、网络或网格中寻找可达路径或最短路径。
scenario_en: The problem asks you to find reachability or a shortest path in a map, network, or grid.
q: 最可能对应哪类算法模式？
q_en: Which algorithmic pattern is the best fit?
options_en: String Matching & Parsing
A simple FIFO cache
Graph Search & Pathfinding
Just sort the input
why: 导航网络、连通结构和路径搜索通常会落到 BFS、DFS、Dijkstra 或 A*。
why_en: Path and connectivity problems usually point to graph search with BFS, DFS, Dijkstra, or A*.
whenOtherWins: 如果问题只是文本模式匹配、没有节点间的连接关系，字符串匹配模式更合适。
tradeoff: 图搜索/寻路（连接关系） vs 字符串匹配（纯文本模式）

termDefinitions.meaning: 广度优先搜索，按层扩展、逐层访问节点的图遍历算法，常用来找无权图最短路径。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BFS explores a graph level by level and is commonly used to find the shortest path in an unweighted graph.

termDefinitions.meaning: 深度优先搜索，沿一条路径尽量往深处走、走不通再回退的图遍历算法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DFS explores a graph by going as deep as possible along one path before backtracking.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种用于带权图的最短路径算法，每次扩展当前已知代价最小的节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Dijkstra's algorithm finds the shortest path in a weighted graph by always expanding the currently cheapest known node.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在 Dijkstra 基础上加入启发式估计，优先扩展更可能接近终点的节点的最短路径算法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A* extends Dijkstra's algorithm with a heuristic estimate to prioritize nodes more likely to be near the goal.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先进先出，最早放入的元素最先被移出的顺序规则，常用于简单缓存淘汰策略。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FIFO means the earliest item added is the first one removed, a simple ordering rule used in basic cache eviction.

optionExplanations: 只有当问题是纯文本token匹配、节点间没有连接关系时，字符串解析才该登场。
FIFO 缓存处理的是淘汰旧数据，不负责在节点间找路径，这里用不上。
对，只要出现网络、网格或路径搜索，BFS/DFS/Dijkstra/A* 就是第一选择。
排序只能处理线性顺序，表达不出节点之间的边和可达性。
optionExplanations_en: Text token matching with no connection between nodes is the only case where string parsing fits.
A FIFO cache handles evicting stale entries, not finding a path between nodes — it doesn't apply here.
Right — whenever a network, grid, or path search shows up, BFS/DFS/Dijkstra/A* are the first choice.
Sorting only handles linear order and can't express edges or reachability between nodes.

q: Graph Search & Pathfinding 这个模式通常会用到哪些算法？（多选）
q_en: Which algorithms are commonly used in Graph Search & Pathfinding? (Select all that apply.)
scenario: 面试给一道地图导航题：无权网格与带权路网都要支持，还限时给出最优路径。
scenario_en: The interview gives you a map-navigation problem that must handle both an unweighted grid and a weighted road network, under a time limit.
options_en: BFS
DFS
Dijkstra's algorithm
A* search
why: 这四种算法是图搜索模式里最常用的核心工具，分别处理无权最短路、遍历和带权/启发式最短路。
why_en: BFS, DFS, Dijkstra, and A* are the core algorithms behind the graph-search pattern.

termDefinitions.meaning: 广度优先搜索，按层扩展的图遍历算法，适合无权图最短路径。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BFS explores a graph level by level and fits unweighted shortest-path problems.

termDefinitions.meaning: 深度优先搜索，沿一条路径走到底再回退的图遍历算法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DFS goes as deep as possible along one path before backtracking.

termDefinitions.meaning: 适合带权图的最短路径算法，每步扩展当前代价最小的节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Dijkstra's algorithm suits weighted graphs, always expanding the cheapest known node.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在 Dijkstra 基础上加启发式，更快逼近目标的最短路径算法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A* adds a heuristic on top of Dijkstra's algorithm to reach the goal faster.

optionExplanations: 按层扩展逐层访问，专门用来找无权图里的最短路径。
沿一条路径走到底再回退，适合遍历和判断节点是否可达。
每步扩展当前代价最小的节点，专门用于带权图的最短路径。
在 Dijkstra 基础上加启发式估计，优先探索更接近终点的节点，收敛更快。
optionExplanations_en: BFS expands level by level and is built for finding the shortest path in an unweighted graph.
DFS follows one path to the end before backtracking, good for traversal and reachability checks.
Dijkstra always expands the currently cheapest node, built for shortest paths on weighted graphs.
A* adds a heuristic on top of Dijkstra to prioritize nodes closer to the goal, converging faster.

scenario: 题目涉及任务依赖、课程先修或构建系统，要求输出合法执行顺序。
scenario_en: The problem involves task dependencies, course prerequisites, or build systems and asks for a valid execution order.
q: 最可能对应哪种算法模式？
q_en: Which algorithmic pattern is the best fit?
options_en: Two pointers
String parsing
Random sampling
Topological Sort
why: 只要事情必须按依赖顺序发生，通常就是有向无环图上的拓扑排序，并要处理 cycle。
why_en: Dependency ordering problems usually map to topological sort over a directed acyclic graph.
whenOtherWins: 如果依赖图里还带边权和最短成本目标，可能需要图最短路而不只是排序。
tradeoff: 拓扑排序（依赖顺序） vs 图最短路（边权成本）

termDefinitions.meaning: 有方向且不存在环的图，任务是节点，依赖是单向边。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A DAG is a directed graph with no cycles, where tasks are nodes and dependencies are one-way edges.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对 DAG 的节点排序，使每条边都从前置任务指向后续任务的排序算法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Topological sort orders the nodes of a DAG so every edge points from a prerequisite task to a dependent one.

optionExplanations: 双指针只对有序数组里的区间扫描有用，处理不了任务之间的先后依赖。
字符串解析处理的是文本语法结构，和课程先修、构建依赖没关系。
随机采样给不出一个能满足所有依赖约束的确定顺序。
对，只要出现依赖顺序，DAG 上的拓扑排序就是第一选择，还要顺带查 cycle。
optionExplanations_en: Two pointers only help scan ranges in a sorted array; it can't express precedence between tasks.
String parsing handles text grammar structure, unrelated to prerequisites or build dependencies.
Random sampling gives no guarantee of an order that satisfies every dependency.
Right — whenever dependency ordering shows up, topological sort on a DAG is the first choice, plus a cycle check.

q: 补全 DAG 含义：
q_en: Complete the meaning of DAG:
text: DAG 是 {{Directed Acyclic Graph}}，也就是有方向、且没有{{环}}的图；拓扑排序常用于依赖顺序。
why: 如果存在环，就没有一个能满足所有依赖的线性顺序，这是拓扑排序必须先验证的点。
why_en: A DAG is a directed acyclic graph, and a cycle means no valid dependency order exists.

scenario: 题目是配置生成、拼图求解或带复杂规则的排班，需要尝试选择、检查约束、失败后撤销。
scenario_en: The problem is configuration generation, puzzle solving, or rule-heavy scheduling where choices are tried, checked, and undone.
q: 最可能对应哪种算法模式？
q_en: Which algorithmic pattern is the best fit?
options_en: Backtracking
Simple aggregation
CDN caching
Binary search only
why: 约束满足题的核心是试探、剪枝、回退，典型模式就是回溯。
why_en: Constraint satisfaction problems usually call for backtracking: try, check, undo, and continue.
whenOtherWins: 如果存在重叠子问题且目标是计数或最优值，动态规划可能更合适。
tradeoff: 回溯（穷举+剪枝+撤销） vs 动态规划（复用重叠子问题）

termDefinitions.meaning: 把内容缓存到靠近用户的边缘节点、加速静态资源分发的网络。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A CDN caches content at edge servers near users to speed up delivery of static resources.

optionExplanations: 对，试探、检查约束、撤销正好对应回溯的核心循环。
聚合统计只能给出汇总数字，产不出满足复杂规则的具体排班方案。
CDN 只负责把内容缓存到边缘节点分发，和约束求解无关。
二分查找只能用在有序空间里，处理不了组合约束问题。
optionExplanations_en: Right — try, check the constraint, then undo maps directly onto backtracking's core loop.
Aggregation only produces summary numbers, not a concrete schedule satisfying complex rules.
A CDN only caches content at edge servers for delivery — unrelated to constraint solving.
Binary search only works over a sorted space and can't handle combinatorial constraints.

scenario: 题目要求分配资源、安排区间或把物品装进容器，局部选择能得到可接受的全局结果。
scenario_en: The problem asks you to allocate resources, schedule intervals, or pack items, where local choices can produce an acceptable global result.
q: 最可能对应哪种算法模式？
q_en: Which algorithmic pattern is the best fit?
options_en: String Matching & Parsing
Greedy & Bin Packing
Topological Sort
A simple FIFO cache
why: 资源分配、区间调度和装箱问题常用贪心或装箱启发式，关键是说明局部选择为什么够好。
why_en: Resource allocation, interval scheduling, and packing problems often map to greedy or bin-packing approaches.
whenOtherWins: 如果需要保证全局最优且存在重叠子问题，动态规划可能胜过贪心。
tradeoff: 贪心（局部最优、更快） vs 动态规划（全局最优、需要重叠子问题）

termDefinitions.meaning: 先进先出，最早放入的元素最先被移出的顺序规则，常用于简单缓存淘汰策略。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FIFO means the earliest item added is the first one removed, a simple ordering rule used in basic cache eviction.

optionExplanations: 字符串匹配/解析处理的是文本模式识别，不解决容量约束下的分配决策。
对，局部选最优、能装得下就够好，正是贪心/装箱该出场的信号。
拓扑排序解决的是先后顺序问题，不解决容量装箱的分配。
FIFO 缓存淘汰旧条目，和把物品装进容器完全是两回事。
optionExplanations_en: String matching and parsing handles text pattern recognition, not allocation decisions under a capacity constraint.
Right — picking the local best that still fits is exactly the cue for greedy or bin packing.
Topological sort solves ordering, not the capacity-packing side of allocation.
FIFO cache eviction is unrelated to packing items into containers under capacity.

scenario: 题目有大量重复子问题，比如编辑距离、带约束的资源分配或路径计数。
scenario_en: The problem has many repeated subproblems, such as edit distance, constrained allocation, or path counting.
q: 最可能对应哪种算法模式？
q_en: Which algorithmic pattern is the best fit?
options_en: Plain DFS without memoization
Hash-only lookup
Dynamic Programming
A FIFO queue only
why: 动态规划的识别信号是“我是否已经解决过一个更小版本”，适合重叠子问题。
why_en: Dynamic programming fits overlapping subproblems where a smaller version has already been solved.
whenOtherWins: 如果没有重叠子问题，只是枚举约束组合，回溯可能更自然。
tradeoff: 动态规划（复用重叠子问题） vs 回溯（穷举+撤销，无重叠子问题）

termDefinitions.meaning: 通过存储并复用更小子问题的解来避免重复计算的算法策略。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Dynamic programming avoids recomputation by storing and reusing the solutions to smaller subproblems.

termDefinitions.meaning: 深度优先搜索，沿一条路径走到底再回退的图/树遍历算法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DFS explores a graph or tree by going as deep as possible along one path before backtracking.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先进先出，最早放入的元素最先被移出的顺序规则。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FIFO means the earliest item added is the first one removed.

optionExplanations: 没有记忆化的 DFS 会重复计算同一个子问题，分支呈指数爆炸。
哈希查找能存结果，但定义不出状态之间怎么转移。
对，编辑距离、约束分配、路径计数都在重复用小问题的解，这正是DP。
FIFO 队列只管先后顺序，不负责判断状态是否重复出现。
optionExplanations_en: DFS without memoization recomputes the same subproblem repeatedly, and branches explode exponentially.
Hash lookup can store a result but can't define how state transitions between subproblems.
Right — edit distance, constrained allocation, and path counting all reuse smaller subproblem solutions, which is DP.
A FIFO queue only tracks order, not whether a state repeats.

scenario: 题目要求模式匹配、文本处理、表达式求值或简单模板引擎。
scenario_en: The problem asks for pattern matching, text processing, expression evaluation, or a simple template engine.
q: 最可能对应哪种算法模式？
q_en: Which algorithmic pattern is the best fit?
options_en: Graph shortest path
Task dependency sorting
Object storage
String Matching & Parsing
why: 这类题围绕字符流、token、规则和解析状态，关键是定义匹配或语法规则。
why_en: Pattern matching, text processing, expression evaluation, and templating usually map to string matching and parsing.
whenOtherWins: 如果文本只是节点标签，核心其实是路径或依赖，图模式才是主线。
tradeoff: 字符串匹配/解析（定义语法规则） vs 图模式（路径/依赖关系）
optionExplanations: 表达式求值没有节点和边权，求不出最短路。
文本处理里字符之间没有先后依赖关系需要排序。
对象存储管的是文件存哪儿，不管怎么解析文本语法规则。
对，字符流、token、语法规则正是这个模式要处理的对象。
optionExplanations_en: Expression evaluation has no nodes or edge weights to compute a shortest path over.
Text processing has no precedence relationship between characters to sort.
Object storage is about where files live, not how text grammar rules get parsed.
Right — character streams, tokens, and grammar rules are exactly what this pattern handles.

scenario: 题目要求组合 map、heap、queue 等基础结构，满足特定性能约束，比如 LRU cache 或 time-based key-value store。
scenario_en: The problem asks you to combine primitives like maps, heaps, or queues to meet a performance constraint, such as an LRU cache or time-based key-value store.
q: 最可能对应哪种算法模式？
q_en: Which algorithmic pattern is the best fit?
options_en: Data Structure Design
Only recursion
Static HTML rendering
A single SQL query
why: 数据结构设计题考你能否把基础结构组合成满足读写复杂度的自定义接口。
why_en: Data-structure design problems ask you to compose primitives into custom structures with specific performance guarantees.
whenOtherWins: 如果主要难点是搜索空间剪枝而不是接口性能，回溯或图搜索可能更关键。
tradeoff: 自定义数据结构（组合读写复杂度） vs 单次查询/渲染（不涉及接口设计）

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种缓存淘汰策略，优先淘汰最久没被访问的条目。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LRU is a cache-eviction policy that removes the item that was least recently accessed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用于查询和操作关系型数据库的标准语言。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SQL is the standard language for querying and manipulating relational databases.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用于描述网页结构的标记语言。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HTML is the markup language used to structure web pages.

optionExplanations: 对，LRU、time-based KV 这类题要把 map/heap/queue 组合成满足读写复杂度的接口。
递归本身不保证接口的时间复杂度，解决不了性能约束。
HTML 渲染管的是页面结构，和内存里维护的数据结构复杂度无关。
一次性 SQL 查询给不出需要持续维护状态的接口。
optionExplanations_en: Right — problems like LRU or a time-based KV store need you to compose map/heap/queue into an interface meeting a performance budget.
Recursion alone doesn't guarantee interface time complexity and can't satisfy a performance constraint.
HTML rendering is about page structure, unrelated to in-memory data-structure complexity.
A single SQL query can't give you an interface that keeps maintaining state.

q: AI coding 面试里常见的模式家族包括哪些？（多选）
q_en: Which pattern families commonly appear in AI coding interviews? (Select all that apply.)
scenario: 45 分钟 AI coding 面试靠模式识别提速，先圈出命中率最高的那批核心模式家族。
scenario_en: In a 45-minute AI coding interview you lean on pattern recognition for speed, so you first pin down the highest-hit-rate core pattern families.
options_en: Graph Search & Pathfinding
Topological Sort
Backtracking
Dynamic Programming
why: 这四个是最常出现的核心模式；另外还有贪心/装箱、字符串匹配和数据结构设计三类补齐完整地图。
why_en: These four are the most common core patterns, alongside greedy/bin packing, string matching, and data-structure design.
optionExplanations: 看到路径、网络或连通性问题，这个模式是第一反应。
看到任务依赖、先修课程或构建顺序，这个模式是第一反应。
遇到试探-检查-撤销这类约束满足问题，就该想到这个模式。
遇到大量重叠子问题，就该想到这个模式。
optionExplanations_en: This pattern is the first instinct whenever paths, networks, or connectivity show up.
This pattern is the first instinct whenever task dependencies, prerequisites, or build order show up.
A try-check-undo constraint-satisfaction problem should make you think of this pattern.
Heavy overlapping subproblems should make you think of this pattern.

q: AI coding 面试模式家族还包括哪些？（多选）
q_en: Which other pattern families belong in the AI coding interview map? (Select all that apply.)
scenario: 同一张模式地图上，图搜索/拓扑/回溯/DP 之外还缺资源分配与文本处理类，要补齐真实模式。
scenario_en: On the same pattern map, beyond graph search, topological sort, backtracking, and DP, you still need the resource-allocation and text-processing families — real patterns only.
options_en: Greedy & Bin Packing
Prompt poetry
String Matching & Parsing
Data Structure Design
why: 这些模式覆盖资源分配、文本处理和自定义结构；“prompt poetry”不是一种真实的算法模式。
why_en: The remaining real patterns cover greedy/bin packing, string matching, and data-structure design; "prompt poetry" is not an algorithmic pattern.
optionExplanations: 资源分配、区间调度或装箱问题一出现，这个模式最先被想到。
这是编造出来的词，不对应任何真实存在的算法模式。
文本处理、表达式求值或简单模板引擎问题一出现，这个模式最先被想到。
要组合 map/heap/queue 满足性能约束时，这个模式最先被想到。
optionExplanations_en: Whenever resource allocation, interval scheduling, or packing shows up, this pattern comes to mind first.
This is a made-up phrase and doesn't correspond to any real algorithmic pattern.
Whenever text processing, expression evaluation, or a template engine shows up, this pattern comes to mind first.
Whenever you need to compose map/heap/queue under a performance budget, this pattern comes to mind first.

scenario: 你准备时间很少，只能先掌握少数高频模式。
scenario_en: You have little preparation time and can only learn a few high-frequency patterns first.
q: 时间紧张时，应该优先理解哪三类模式？
q_en: When time is tight, which three patterns should you understand first?
options_en: Only dynamic programming, only regex, only sorting.
Graph search, topological sort, and backtracking.
CSS, HTML, and SQL.
Caching, sharding, and load balancing.
why: 时间紧张时优先懂图搜索、拓扑排序和回溯，这三类最近覆盖了大多数被观察到的题目。
why_en: With limited time, prioritize graph search, topological sort, and backtracking, since they cover most recently observed problems.
whenOtherWins: 如果目标题库明显偏字符串处理或自定义结构，也要补对应的那类模式。
tradeoff: 先攻高频三类（图搜索/拓扑/回溯） vs 面面俱到但每类都学不深
diagram:
flowchart TD
  Minimum[Minimum study] --> Graph[Graph search]
  Minimum --> Topo[Topological sort]
  Minimum --> Backtrack[Backtracking]
  Graph --> Prompt[Better prompts]
  Topo --> Prompt
  Backtrack --> Prompt

termDefinitions.meaning: 用于描述网页样式的语言，和算法判断无关。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CSS is the language for styling web pages and is unrelated to algorithmic judgment.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用于描述网页结构的标记语言。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HTML is the markup language used to structure web pages.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用于查询和操作关系型数据库的标准语言。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SQL is the standard language for querying and manipulating relational databases.

optionExplanations: 只挑单一窄模式各学一种，覆盖面不够，时间紧时更需要广度优先。
对，这三类合起来覆盖了近期观察到的大多数题目，时间紧就先攻它们。
CSS/HTML/SQL 是前端和数据库技术，不解决算法判断问题。
缓存/分片/负载均衡属于系统设计范畴，不是编码算法模式。
optionExplanations_en: Picking one narrow pattern from each family gives too little coverage when time is short.
Right — these three together cover most recently observed problems, so prioritize them under time pressure.
CSS/HTML/SQL are front-end and database technologies, unrelated to algorithmic judgment.
Caching/sharding/load balancing belong to system design, not coding algorithm patterns.

scenario: 面试中 AI 突然给出了一段基于 Monte Carlo Tree Search 的实现，而你此前从未接触过这个算法。
scenario_en: In an interview, AI suddenly produces an implementation based on Monte Carlo Tree Search, but you have never studied it before.
q: 为什么不能指望在面试现场临时学会这类深模式？
q_en: Why can't you count on learning this kind of deep pattern during the interview?
options: 因为 AI 在面试里完全不被允许主动提到这个算法的名字
因为所有偏门的深度算法模式在面试里都毫无用处
如果完全陌生，你很难有效引导 AI 或验证它给出的复杂输出
因为面试官在这类面试里从来不会问任何算法问题
options_en: Because the AI is never allowed to bring up this algorithm's name at all.
Because every obscure deep algorithmic pattern is useless in interviews.
If you're completely unfamiliar with it, you can't effectively steer the AI or verify its complex output.
Because interviewers in this format never ask about any algorithms at all.
why: AI 可能给出深入实现，但你如果没有预备理解，就无法判断它是否合适或正确。
why_en: You cannot rely on learning a deep pattern mid-interview because you must still steer and verify it under time pressure.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种通过大量随机模拟来评估决策价值、常用于博弈/规划问题的搜索算法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Monte Carlo Tree Search evaluates decisions by running many random simulations, often used in game-playing and planning problems.

optionExplanations: AI 没有被限制讨论特定算法，这个说法是凭空编造的。
深模式一旦真出现，它的价值判断权很关键，说它毫无用处不成立。
对，完全陌生的深模式会让你既没法引导 AI，也没法验证它给出的输出。
深模式出现时问题自然会围绕它展开，说面试官不问算法不成立。
optionExplanations_en: AI isn't restricted from naming a specific algorithm — this claim is invented.
Once a deep pattern actually appears, judging its fit matters a lot; calling it useless doesn't hold.
Right — total unfamiliarity with a deep pattern breaks both steering the AI and verifying what it hands back.
When a deep pattern shows up, the conversation naturally centers on it — this claim doesn't hold.

scenario: 你识别出题目是依赖排序，需要让 AI 实现而不是自己逐行写。
scenario_en: You identify the problem as dependency ordering and want AI to implement it instead of writing every line yourself.
q: 哪条提示最体现正确的模式驱动？
q_en: Which prompt best shows correct pattern-driven AI use?
options: 跟 AI 说 solve this somehow，完全不给出具体思路、建模方式或错误处理方式，全靠它自己猜
跟 AI 说这是依赖问题，用 sliding window 从头到尾扫描任务顺序而不建边
跟 AI 说帮我写一个让面试官觉得很厉害、看起来很高级很炫的算法，不用管是不是拓扑排序
用拓扑排序做任务调度：tasks 是节点，dependencies 是有向边，出现 cycle 就报错
options_en: Tell the AI "solve this somehow" without giving any concrete method, modeling, or error handling at all, leaving it to guess.
Tell the AI it's a dependency problem and to scan tasks start-to-end with a sliding window, without modeling edges.
Tell the AI to write something flashy that will make the interviewer think it looks sophisticated, regardless of whether it's topological sort.
Implement task scheduling with topological sort: tasks are nodes, dependencies are directed edges, return an error on a cycle.
why: 提示明确点出了模式、建模方式和关键失败条件，AI 执行的是你的判断，而不是自己瞎猜。
why_en: The prompt names the pattern, the modeling, and the failure case, so the AI executes your decision instead of guessing.
whenOtherWins: 如果依赖还带资源容量或时间窗口，可能要在拓扑排序外再组合贪心或约束搜索。
tradeoff: 点名模式+建模+失败条件 vs 含糊描述让 AI 自由发挥
codeSample:
Implement task scheduling with topological sort.
Model each task as a node and each dependency as a directed edge.
Return a valid order, or return an explicit cycle error if none exists.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对 DAG 的节点排序，使每条边都从前置任务指向后续任务的排序算法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Topological sort orders the nodes of a DAG so every edge points from a prerequisite task to a dependent one.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种维护一个连续区间随窗口移动增删元素的技巧，常用于数组/字符串区间统计。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A sliding window is a technique that maintains a moving contiguous range over an array or string.

optionExplanations: 这种提示没有传达任何你的判断，AI 只能自己瞎猜，产出大概率不对。
把滑动窗口硬套在依赖排序上，AI会顺着错误提示扭曲出方案。
追求代码看起来高级不等于方法正确，不管模式对不对，AI 可能被引向错误方向。
对，点名模式、建模方式和 cycle 失败条件，AI 执行的是你想清楚的判断。
optionExplanations_en: This prompt conveys none of your judgment, so AI is left to guess on its own and the result is unlikely to be right.
Forcing a sliding window onto dependency ordering makes AI contort a solution around the wrong prompt.
Chasing code that merely looks sophisticated doesn't mean it's correct, regardless of pattern — AI may head the wrong way.
Right — naming the pattern, modeling, and the cycle failure case lets AI execute a judgment you already made.

q: 识别模式后，验证 AI 输出时应检查哪些点？（多选）
q_en: After identifying the pattern, what should you check when verifying AI output? (Select all that apply.)
scenario: AI 刚生成一段图搜索代码，你只有 5 分钟复核，要挑真正决定正确性的检查点。
scenario_en: The AI just produced graph-search code and you have five minutes to review it, so you pick only the checks that actually decide correctness.
options: 是否真的使用了你选择的模式
是否处理了该模式的典型失败条件
复杂度是否符合题目约束
options_en: Whether all the variable names are long.
Whether the AI actually used the pattern you chose.
Whether it handles that pattern's typical failure cases.
Whether the complexity matches the problem's constraints.
why: 模式验证不只是看代码能跑，还要看是否覆盖 cycle、不可达、剪枝、边界等模式特有风险。
why_en: Pattern-based verification checks the chosen approach, its failure cases, and complexity, not just whether the code runs.
optionExplanations: 变量命名风格和代码是否正确无关，不该拿来当验证标准。
确认 AI 真的按你判断的模式实现，而不是偷偷换了别的方法。
确认 cycle、不可达这类模式特有的失败场景真的被覆盖到了。
确认时间/空间复杂度没有超出题目给的约束，不只是能跑就行。
optionExplanations_en: Variable-naming style has nothing to do with whether the code is correct — it's not a verification signal.
Confirm AI actually implemented the pattern you chose, not something else it swapped in quietly.
Confirm pattern-specific failure cases like cycles or unreachability are actually handled.
Confirm time/space complexity stays within what the problem allows, not just that it runs.

scenario: 一个题目既要按依赖顺序安排任务，又要在同一时间段内满足资源容量限制。
scenario_en: A problem must schedule tasks in dependency order while also respecting resource capacity in each time window.
q: 面对这种题目，最合理的判断是什么？
q_en: What is the most reasonable judgment for this kind of problem?
options: 可能需要拓扑排序加贪心或约束处理，不一定只有一个模式
这道题只能靠字符串匹配来解决，别的都不用考虑
这道题只要写一个排序函数就能完全搞定
AI 会自动帮你判断该用哪些模式，候选人完全不用操心
options_en: It may need topological sort combined with greedy or constraint handling, not just one pattern.
This problem can only be solved with string matching, nothing else needed.
This problem is fully solved by writing a single sort function.
The AI automatically figures out which patterns to use, so the candidate doesn't need to judge.
why: 很多题会拉入多个模式，识别主线模式和需要组合的约束是候选人的责任。
why_en: Many problems combine patterns, so the candidate must identify the main approach and the supporting constraints.
whenOtherWins: 如果题目只要求合法依赖顺序且没有资源约束，单纯拓扑排序就足够。
tradeoff: 拓扑排序+贪心/约束组合 vs 单一模式硬套整道题
optionExplanations: 对，先用拓扑排序定顺序，再叠加贪心或约束处理容量限制，两个模式都要用。
字符串匹配处理不了依赖关系和容量约束，这里根本用不上。
单纯排序给不出同时满足依赖和资源限制的合法安排。
AI 不会替你判断该组合哪些模式，识别模式始终是候选人的工作。
optionExplanations_en: Right — topological sort fixes the order first, then greedy or constraint handling covers capacity; more than one pattern is needed.
String matching can't represent dependencies or capacity limits — it doesn't apply here at all.
Plain sorting alone can't produce a schedule that satisfies both dependency and capacity constraints.
AI won't decide which patterns to combine for you — recognizing the pattern stays the candidate's job.

scenario: 两位候选人都能脱口说出“这是拓扑排序题”，但只有一位能讲清楚为什么，并在 AI 跑偏时纠正它。
scenario_en: Two candidates can both say "this is topological sort," but only one can explain why and correct the AI when it drifts.
q: 学习算法模式的真正目标是什么？
q_en: What is the real goal of learning algorithmic patterns?
options: 学习模式的目标只是为了能一眼认出问题属于哪种形状
形成解决一类问题的感觉，而不是把模式机械映射到题目模板
学习模式的目标只是为了能验证 AI 给出的输出对不对
学习模式的目标只是为了能顺利地和面试官进行沟通
options_en: The goal is only to recognize which shape a problem belongs to at a glance.
It's to build a feel for solving a family of problems, not a rigid problem-to-template map.
The goal is only to be able to verify whether AI's output is correct.
The goal is only to be able to communicate smoothly with the interviewer.
why: 算法模式知识服务于判断和引导 AI，而不是背一张固定题目到模板的表。
why_en: The goal is a feel for solving a family of problems, not a rigid problem-to-template map.
tradeoff: 形成可迁移的判断感 vs 死记题目到模板的一一对应
optionExplanations: 只认出形状但讲不清原因，遇到题目变体或 AI 跑偏时照样卡住。
对，形成可迁移的判断感，才顶得住题目变体和 AI 跑偏这两关。
只会验证不算全部，验证不了 AI 一开始就选错方法这件事。
沟通依赖判断力支撑，脱离判断力的沟通没有实质内容可讲。
optionExplanations_en: Recognizing the shape alone, without being able to explain it, still leaves you stuck on variants or AI drift.
Right — building a transferable feel for the problem family is what holds up against variants and AI drift.
Verification alone isn't the whole goal — it can't catch AI picking the wrong approach in the first place.
Communication depends on judgment; without it there's nothing substantive left to say.

q: 把强候选人的模式使用信号排好：
q_en: Put the strong candidate signals for using patterns in order:
steps: 读懂并测试 AI 给出的实现
把问题形状映射到合适模式
用具体约束提示 AI 实现
向面试官说明为什么这个模式适合
why: 强信号是你识别形状、解释选择、指导实现并验证结果，而不是只会说出模式名字。
why_en: Strong candidates map the shape, explain the pattern, prompt with constraints, and verify the implementation.
tradeoff: 识别+解释+指导+验证的完整闭环 vs 只会说出模式名字不会应用
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Signal[Recognize pattern] --> Choose[Choose approach]
  Choose --> Prompt[Guide AI]
  Prompt --> Check[Check pattern invariants]
  Check --> Explain[Explain tradeoffs]

scenario: 你在读 backtracking 模式页备考 AI coding 面试:实现交给 AI 写,你只有 45 分钟做判断。
scenario_en: You're reading the backtracking pattern page to prep for an AI coding interview: the AI writes the implementation, and you only have 45 minutes to make judgment calls.
q: 这一页最该让你能回答哪组问题?
q_en: Which set of questions should the page leave you able to answer?
options: 它解决什么问题、如何识别、怎么告诉 AI、如何验证输出
把参考实现逐行背下来,连同它的复杂度证明和所有边界写法
它的发明历史、命名由来,以及哪些经典竞赛原题考过它
记住模式的英文名字就够,剩下思路完全交给 AI 发挥
options_en: What it solves, how to recognize it, how to tell the AI, and how to verify the output.
Memorize the reference implementation line by line, plus its complexity proof and every edge case.
Its invention history, how it got its name, and which classic contest problems have used it.
Just remember the pattern's name and leave all the thinking to the AI.
why: AI 负责写实现,你带来的是判断,所以模式页围绕解决什么问题、如何识别、怎么提示、如何验证这四问展开;逐行背实现在 AI 面试里价值很低。
why_en: The AI writes the code, so each pattern page is built around four questions: what it solves, how to recognize it, how to prompt for it, and how to verify the output.

termDefinitions.meaning: 回溯,一种试探选择、检查约束、失败后撤销再换一个选择的搜索方法,常用于约束满足问题。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Backtracking is a search method that tries a choice, checks constraints, and undoes it on a dead end, often used for constraint-satisfaction problems.

optionExplanations: 对,AI 面试里实现是 AI 的活,能回答这四问才是你要带来的判断力。
逐行背实现是传统白板面试的打法;这里 AI 一键就能写出来,背它挤占了练判断的时间。
历史和竞赛出处是趣闻,现场既帮不了你识别模式,也帮不了你验证 AI 的输出。
只报名字讲不出为什么合适,AI 一旦跑偏你既纠正不了也验证不了。
optionExplanations_en: Right — in an AI interview the implementation is the AI's job, so answering these four questions is the judgment you bring.
Memorizing the implementation is the whiteboard-era play; here the AI writes it instantly, so drilling it steals time from practicing judgment.
History and contest origins are trivia — they help you neither recognize the pattern nor verify the AI's output on the spot.
Just naming it can't explain why it fits, so when the AI drifts you can neither correct nor verify it.
